evidence.excerpt:
## What the owner decided (may not change)

- One flat panel, all jacks above all controls; hardware positions fixed.
- Jack bushings clamp to the panel with their nuts. No recessed jack behind a plug-sized hole. No raising the whole panel to suit one part.
- Flat panel plus height-compatible interface boards and a rear core (decision D09). The handoff's own architecture page adds: "Merge or split boards only after demonstrating the full mechanical and electrical interface. A large number of boards is not a requirement in itself."
- The pot family, the octave selector and both toggle types. The push button is only a candidate and may change to another height variant of its family.
- Each selected power assembly needs its own dimensioned pocket, support and cable exits under #48. A pinned P+B assembly is about 116 × 91 mm and 25 mm tall; a one-pocket preview does not establish room for multiple assemblies.
- All soldering by a factory. Connector friction and solder joints are not structural support for plug insertion, knob torque or button presses.
- Timing, hold, integrator and slew storage nodes never cross a connector.

evidence.excerpt:
## Purpose

Persistent physical qualification of the conditional nine-board stack selected in #35. CAD courtyard, cable-corridor, power-loss and support-hole checks do not prove assembled fit, stiffness or strain relief. This issue remains open after the unvalidated draft PCB work; it does not authorize procurement or fabrication.

## Required first-article evidence

- Build a representative stack coupon at the fixed panel hardware centres, covering jack nut/plug load, bushingless pot knob torque, toggle/button actuation, the rear core at its selected depth, and all optical/selector carrier planes. Measure true seated hardware heights, body/shaft/collar clearances, panel thickness and tolerance stack; verify no jack/control coordinate moved.
- Verify every proposed internal M2/M3 support, collar and enclosure carrier load path, fastener exact identity, captive assembly access and repeated insertion/actuation stiffness. Solder joints and connector friction must not be the structural support.
- Factory-assemble representative JST GH3/GH7/GH8 harnesses using selected exact wire, crimp and housing. Measure insertion/extraction retention, wire pull force, bend radius, loom clearance, chafe/strain relief, routing, connector access and board removal sequence. Audit pin 1 and all signal/AGND/rail continuity against #36's cross-board map.
- Measure hot wire/contact and plane resistance, normal and single-fault return currents, rail/AGND displacement and load-side voltage loss with credible operating and startup loads. Do not assume balanced current among parallel AGND contacts or patch sleeves. Coordinate power-off/partial-return behavior with exact protection issue #59 and source/inlet issue #57.
- Record coupon revisions, ambient, instruments, photos, dimensions, load cases and failure limits. If a deterministic conflict is found, revise #35 sources and affected board projects before any claim of fit or release.

Links: #1, #35, #36, #37, #38–#43, #55 selector-specific, #57 source/inlet, #59 exact protection, #64 optical/hot LED. All schematics/PCBs remain unvalidated drafts. No order files, purchases, quotes, supplier contact or deployment.
